title: SafetyInfinity: a safety-refusal slice of Infinity-Chat for measuring shared refusal blind spots

original_idea.body: Curate ~150 borderline safety prompts, label refuse/comply across 8-12 models, compute CAPA-style agreement (arXiv:2510.22954, arXiv:2502.04313).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: correlated refusal blind spots defeat defense-in-depth redundancy.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt curation + LLM-judge + CAPA; reused taxonomy.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped releasable mini-benchmark with one agreement statistic.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected long-horizon diffuse-reward safety evaluation; third-party scrutiny.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on 8-12 open models or APIs.

novelty.reasoning: Safety-refusal slice with CAPA on refusal decisions mostly unexplored.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Correlated refusal blind-spot slice mostly novel.
